# Software Bill of Materials (SBOM)

<!-- Generated by tools/sbom.py — do not edit by hand. Regenerate with `python3 tools/sbom.py`. -->

PP Forge **0.1.0** ships an SBOM in [CycloneDX 1.5](https://cyclonedx.org/) JSON format for each release platform.
The machine-readable files live in [`sbom/`](../sbom/) and are attached to every GitHub Release.
CI regenerates them on every push and fails if the committed copies are out of date, so they always match `Cargo.lock` and the embedded data.

## Files

| Platform | SBOM file | Third-party packages |
|---|---|---|
| Windows (x86-64) | [`sbom/pp_forge-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.cdx.json`](../sbom/pp_forge-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.cdx.json) | 225 |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | [`sbom/pp_forge-aarch64-apple-darwin.cdx.json`](../sbom/pp_forge-aarch64-apple-darwin.cdx.json) | 234 |
| macOS (Intel) | [`sbom/pp_forge-x86_64-apple-darwin.cdx.json`](../sbom/pp_forge-x86_64-apple-darwin.cdx.json) | 235 |
| Linux (x86-64) | [`sbom/pp_forge-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.cdx.json`](../sbom/pp_forge-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.cdx.json) | 324 |

Across all platforms: **379** distinct third-party packages, all from crates.io and each pinned by version and SHA-256 checksum in `Cargo.lock` (453 lock entries, including target-specific ones). The counts differ by platform because Rust only compiles each operating system's own windowing, graphics and file-dialog libraries.

## Direct dependencies

| Package | Version | License | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `directories` | 6.0.0 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 | Per-OS settings and Documents folder locations |
| `eframe` | 0.37.0 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 | Native window, event loop and rendering (wgpu, with OpenGL fallback) |
| `egui` | 0.37.0 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 | Immediate-mode GUI widgets |
| `printpdf` | 0.7.0 | MIT | PDF character sheet export |
| `rfd` | 0.17.2 | MIT | Native open/save file dialogs |
| `serde` | 1.0.229 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 | Serialization framework (save files, rules data) |
| `serde_json` | 1.0.154 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 | JSON reading/writing for `.ppchar` files and rules data |

Everything else is a transitive dependency of these.

## Embedded data

These files are compiled into the executable and are listed in each SBOM as `data` components with SHA-256 hashes.

| File | Source document | Generated by | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data/core_rules.json` | Prowlers_&_Paragons_Ultimate_Edition.pdf (core rulebook, as printed) | `tools/build_core_rules.py` | `45f90928a5affb86…` |
| `data/errata_rules.json` | Combined_Updates.pdf (Combined Updates / errata document) | `tools/build_errata_rules.py` | `301cce3ca2044671…` |

The data holds game mechanics (names, ranges, ranks, costs, modifier values) and short paraphrased summaries, not rulebook text. See [RULES_DATA.md](RULES_DATA.md).

## Licenses worth noting

Nearly everything is permissively licensed (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, Zlib, ISC, Unicode, BSL). The packages below carry other terms. None of them is strong copyleft for a distributed binary, but they come with attribution or file-level obligations:

| Package | Version | License |
|---|---|---|
| `epaint_default_fonts` | 0.37.0 | `(MIT OR Apache-2.0) AND OFL-1.1 AND Ubuntu-font-1.0` |
| `option-ext` | 0.2.0 | `MPL-2.0` |
| `self_cell` | 1.3.0 | `Apache-2.0 OR GPL-2.0-only` |

Where an expression offers a choice (`A OR B`), PP Forge can use the permissive option.

## PP Forge's own license

PP Forge itself does not yet declare a license (`Cargo.toml` has no `license` field and there is no `LICENSE` file). Until one is chosen, the code is "all rights reserved" by default. See the open items in [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md#10-open-items).

## Regenerating

```sh
cargo install cargo-cyclonedx --version 0.5.9 --locked   # once
python3 tools/sbom.py            # after changing Cargo.toml / Cargo.lock or data/
python3 tools/sbom.py --check    # what CI runs
```
